spec.bear_gate_weekly: Original weekly short leaders only while closed BTC is below EMA21 and 28d return <= -3%; exit next observed quote when regime fails
spec.failed_rebound: BTC bear gate; asset below EMA21 with 28d return <= -3%; previous two closed days rallied >=3%, then latest day closed lower; top two by negative 28d momentum/volatility
spec.bear_channel7: BTC bear gate; asset below EMA21 with 28d return <= -3%; close below previous seven daily lows; top two by negative 28d momentum/volatility
spec.exits: New daily families retain below EMA21 while BTC bear gate holds; same 6–20% ATR-derived stop/trailing; 28-day maximum hold
spec.allocation: Unchanged aggressive 3% risk budget, full notional reservation, no added leverage
spec.eligibility: Only the original formation universe intersected with the current published US pair list
spec.financing: Illustrative light and medium opening/four-hour rates; no historical quote claim

formation_universe.limitation: Selection uses formation data only; published-archive omissions can still introduce survivorship bias. Later missing members do not remove an asset.

limitations: Reused development data and a post-selected short-only hypothesis; not independent validation.
Current US pair list checked October 3, 2026; historical March–June eligibility and product availability are not reconstructed.
Illustrative rates, not historical or current execution quotes. Actual rates are dynamic and must be captured at order time.
Full notional is reserved: no leverage increase. Actual collateral, liquidation, borrow availability and account minimums remain unmodeled.
Opening and four-hour fees use a simplified shadow USD conversion of borrowed-asset charges at observed marks.
Overdue charges are assessed when the feed returns, with due/assessment/quote timestamps; missing execution quotes are not invented.
Only Kraken taker tiers are used. These remain cost sensitivities, not venue-native performance evidence.
Operating costs are user-supplied sensitivities. No paper entry resumes or broker orders.
